description.value: Ton Ton Sushi is a Japanese and Korean sushi restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver, serving sushi and a fusion of Japanese and Korean dishes. The restaurant offers online ordering through their website and a dedicated app. Located along the Cambie Street corridor near the Canada Line, it is a convenient stop for cyclists moving through South Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 77m; building (12 spaces, covered, paid) at 99m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (4018 Cambie St, Vancouver, BC) and phone number (604-428-2742), and explicitly offers online ordering, supporting a Takeout value of true. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. OSM opening hours omit Monday, but the website lists Monday hours (11:30 AM–9:30 PM), flagged as a discrepancy in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag omits Monday (Tu-Fr only), but the website lists Monday 11:30 AM–9:30 PM; OSM hours should be updated.

Website title references 'New Westminster | Broadway Vancouver' alongside the Cambie St location, suggesting multiple locations exist; the OSM record and website contact block both refer to 4018 Cambie St specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by a live website with matching contact details. Useful to touring cyclists as a full-service dining stop on the Cambie corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website includes a temporary construction notice: '23rd Ave Closed For Construction. Parking may be limited. Please enter via King Edward Ave or Yukon Street.' This may affect cyclist access from that direction.
